review_candidates.description: Company:  Social Chameleon Location:  Remote (UK) — must be within reasonable commuting distance of London Contract:  Full-time, Permanent Salary:  £28,000 per annum (proposed) Experience:  1–2 years in a relevant or customer-facing role ABOUT US Social Chameleon is an award-winning, social-first creative and digital agency working with ambitious brands across the UK and internationally. With offices in London and Sydney, we specialise in social media strategy, content creation, influencer marketing, paid media and digital innovation. We're a fast-growing, ambitious team that prides itself on delivering exceptional creative work alongside an equally exceptional client experience. We're now looking for a bright, energetic and highly organised Junior Account Manager to join our client services team. THE ROLE We're looking for someone who's sharp, personable, relentlessly organised and knows how to get things done. Someone who loves working with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes genuine pride in making sure every detail is taken care of. You'll support the day-to-day management of client relationships and projects, working closely with our account managers, strategists and creative teams to ensure that work is delivered on time, to brief and to an exceptional standard. You'll be a key point of contact for clients, helping coordinate communications, manage deliverables, track deadlines and keep projects moving. This role is ideal for someone with 1–2 years of experience in a client-facing position who wants to build a career in account management within the creative and digital marketing industry. You don't necessarily need agency experience. We're looking for someone with the right attitude, instincts and interpersonal skills. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Client Relationship Management- Support the day-to-day management of client accounts, building positive and professional relationships. Act as a reliable point of contact for client communications, queries and requests. Respond to client enquiries promptly, professionally and with a solutions-focused approach. Help ensure clients feel informed, supported and confident in the work we're delivering. Attend client meetings, prepare agendas, take accurate notes and follow up on agreed actions. Develop a strong understanding of each client's business, objectives and expectations. Project Management & Delivery- Coordinate projects and deliverables across internal strategy, creative, social media and production teams. Maintain accurate project timelines, task lists and delivery schedules. Proactively follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure work progresses according to plan. Identify potential delays, bottlenecks or issues early and work with the team to resolve them. Ensure client feedback is accurately documented, communicated and actioned. Support the preparation and quality checking of client deliverables before submission. Keep project management systems and internal documentation organised and up to date. Account Admin & Organisation- Maintain accurate records of client communications, project activity, deliverables and deadlines. Coordinate regular client updates, status reports and meeting schedules. Prepare meeting notes, action trackers, presentations and supporting documents. Assist with monitoring project scope and flagging additional requests or potential scope changes. Support the preparation of information required for client reporting and invoicing. Help improve the efficiency and consistency of internal account management processes. Communication & Collaboration- Work closely with account managers and senior team members to ensure seamless client delivery. Communicate clearly and confidently with clients and internal stakeholders. Support the wider team in managing competing priorities and deadlines. Take initiative in identifying what needs to happen next, without waiting to be asked. Approach challenges with energy, resourcefulness and a willingness to find solutions. ABOUT YOU Essential- Approximately 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing, client services, account management, customer success or similar role. A naturally outgoing, personable and engaging personality, with excellent interpersonal skills. Exceptional organisational skills and an ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Outstanding attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A proactive, tenacious and solutions-oriented attitude. Quick-thinking, resourceful and able to use initiative. Comfortable following up, chasing outstanding actions and holding people accountable to deadlines. Confident interacting with clients and building positive professional relationships. Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility within a remote team. A genuine interest in brands, marketing, social media and the creative industries. Based within reasonable commuting distance of London and able to attend occasional in-person meetings, shoots and team activities. Desirable- Previous experience in a marketing, advertising, creative or digital agency. Experience working with project management tools such as Monday.com Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing terminology. Experience coordinating multiple projects, stakeholders or client accounts. Experience preparing client presentations, reports or meeting documentation. Formal marketing qualifications are not essential. We're more interested in your ability to communicate, organise, problem-solve and build relationships. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Beyond your experience, there are a few qualities that really matter to us. You're exceptionally organised.  You're the person who remembers the details, anticipates deadlines and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You're a natural people person.  You're warm, bubbly and confident, and you genuinely enjoy building relationships. You're sharp.  You pick things up quickly, understand what's being asked and can think on your feet. You're tenacious.  You're comfortable chasing answers, following up on outstanding actions and making sure things actually get done. You take ownership.  You don't just identify problems -you actively help solve them. You care about the details.  Whether it's a client email, a presentation or a project timeline, you take pride in getting things right. WHAT WE OFFER £28,000 annual salary. Remote working with occasional travel to London. The opportunity to work with exciting national and international brands. Exposure to a wide range of creative, social media and digital marketing projects. The chance to learn directly from experienced account managers, strategists and creative professionals. A collaborative, ambitious team where initiative and ideas are valued. Opportunities for professional development and career progression as the agency grows. HOW TO APPLY Please send your CV and a short introduction explaining why you'd be a great fit for the role. We're looking for someone who can combine great people skills with exceptional organisation, initiative and attention to detail.
